# dist/

Local packaging output — zips, `.app` bundles, anything assembled for
distribution outside this repo. Gitignored: nothing under here is ever
committed (this file is force-added as the one exception, so the directory
and its purpose show up in a clone).

Distinct from `zig-out/`: that's `zig build`'s own install prefix, wiped and
regenerated by the build itself. `dist/` is for a packaging step layered on
top of a build (today, nothing automates this yet — see
[`docs/product/roadmap.md`](../docs/product/roadmap.md) for the native
packaging/install-location decision).

Past precedent: a preview zip was committed to git on a throwaway branch
(`release/native-preview-2026-10-17`) while GitHub Releases were blocked by a
credential gap. That branch is gone — don't repeat the pattern. If Releases
are reachable, use those for anything meant to leave this machine; `dist/`
is for local use only.
